closureWorkflow: Assign/confirm the domain owner for each open risk or decision.
Approve the actual rule explicitly; do not infer it from source defaults.
Update affected contracts, code and tests under the corresponding package step.
Run the relevant static validators at each checkpoint and retain their evidence.
After all four packages are implemented, run approved physical/build/database/device/provider/E2E tests and link the evidence.
Re-evaluate each risk; only an explicitly authorized, policy-permitted accepted risk may be marked accepted. Mandatory P0 failures are not waivable.
Keep the pre-LIVE gate blocked until every applicable blocking item is evidence-backed and approved.
